items.name: Kolvo account plan FY27.docx
items.content:
Kolvo account plan FY27

Owner: Alex, key account manager. Last updated: 12 November 2026. Classification: Internal.

1. Account summary
Kolvo AB builds trucks. Its cab plant in Hisingen, Gothenburg, runs three body presses (press lines 1 to 3) on Strandvik SD-900 drive units and one stamping line on an SD-700. Service contract SC-KOL-2024, annual value 1,240,000 EUR.

2. Strategy
Kolvo is a strategic account. Uptime matters more than price: a stopped press line stops cab production for the whole truck plant. Kolvo has told us they would rather pay for fast freight than lose a shift.

3. Relationship
Main contact: Maria, production manager press shop. Maria uses an agent (maria-procurement) to ask suppliers for price and delivery at night. It never orders without her.

4. Competition
Nordic Drive Parts (distributor, fast answers from a stock list) and Hallberg Repair Services (repair shop, office hours only).

5. Actions FY27
Quarterly uptime review with Maria. Condition monitoring on press line 2, the oldest SD-900. Renewal proposal for SC-KOL-2024 by end of January 2027.
